hypotheses.C0_endpoints_reproduce: Empty and full masks exactly reproduce the established direct- and full-tensor analytic tangents.
hypotheses.C1_compact_reusable_router: The frozen best subset of at most three suffix attention layers reaches median finite-effect Fisher fidelity and full-response objective efficiency of at least 0.90 on both held-out corpora.
hypotheses.C2_broad_suffix_required: No frozen subset of at most three reaches 0.80 effect fidelity on both corpora, the full mask reaches at least 0.98, and at least six layers are required to first cross 0.90 on one or both corpora.
hypotheses.C3_selection_transfers_ood: At the selected compact size, the FineWeb-discovered mask exceeds the median matched random mask on WikiText by at least 0.05 effect fidelity.
hypotheses.C4_attention_signal_is_detectable: A ten-percent interpolation from the direct tangent toward the full attention tangent changes the response by a detectable nonzero amount and orders below the full endpoint.
